alt: An open studio floor with kitchen at one end and desk work zone at the other, with a floor-to-ceiling bookshelf along one wall, shown in four distinct material schemes from forest green lacquer walls and pale cabinetry to charcoal limewash and natural ash, all lit by late afternoon winter sun raking across the floor.
text:
four versions of one afternoon light.

one room, four material worlds. forest green lacquer, pale cabinetry, charcoal limewash, natural ash. the third one is the one I live in.

winter sun reads completely differently in each.

#studiodesign #wintermaterials #layering #lightandshadow #materiality

provenance.base_prompt: An open studio floor seen from well within the space, positioned off the central axis, revealing the full width wall to wall and both floor and ceiling. At the far end, a kitchen counter with open shelving above holds cabinetry with a single tap set into the worktop; a row of paper-shade pendants hangs above at varying heights. A tall glazed wall behind the counter frames a city skyline at dusk with lights beginning to show across the horizon. Along one side, a floor-to-ceiling bookshelf runs the length, displaying books at varying depths, ceramic vessels, sculptural objects, framed artworks, and small details at multiple scales — the room's main architectural anchor. In the center-foreground area, a sculptural sofa with oat-wool linen upholstery sits beside a low table; a sculptural floor lamp with a paper shade stands beside the seating. A small round dining table seats two and is positioned beside the kitchen counter, facing into the room. To the opposite side, a minimal desk workstation with a single chair and a task lamp faces the open room. Trailing plants hang from shelving and sit on surfaces at various heights. Glassware, books, and carefully placed objects populate open shelves throughout. The floor is lit by low winter sun entering at four o'clock, raking across the surface at a sharp angle, creating defined striping and shadows across the space. Textiles — throws and a rug in layered fibers — sit in the seating zone. All walkways between zones remain clear and navigable
